//: Coverage baseline for the NODE-EXECUTED layer. Nine parity suites import the
pure v2/src/stores/*-logic.js (and lib/*) modules in node and drive them
directly (the browser suites run .vue/store code in Chromium, which node
coverage cannot see — so this measures the logic layer, which is exactly the
layer those suites are built to pin). `all: false` keeps 0%-in-node files
(the .vue and Pinia stores) out of the number rather than reporting them as
untested, which they are not — they are tested in the browser.
